top_issues: The 'How to read this' explainer panel takes roughly a third of the viewport and has no persisted dismiss state, so it is permanent noise for returning users.
The stacked balance bar shows $0.00 on-chain and $0.00 secured as empty graph segments, which can read as 'missing money' to a first-timer.
The violet 'Promised $115.00' is the largest slice and is exactly the riskiest money, but a novice has to read the explainer to learn that violet = hub promise.
The 'Instant: send up to 175.00, receive up to 250.75' line has no unit/purpose gloss and sits crowded between the explainer and the action buttons.
fixes: Make the explainer dismissible, persist the 'Got it' state, and collapse it to a '?' info button on subsequent visits.
Label the violet segment directly on the bar ('promised') so the risk is visible without reading copy.
Add a persistent one-line strip 'Yours now 40.00 · Promised 115.00' under the total for instant risk reading.
Change the instant-capacity line to 'You can send up to 175.00 right now' with a small 'why?' tooltip.

top_issues: The two renders disagree: 02-pay shows a collapsed '1 OTHER ROUTE' while 02-pay-bottom shows an expanded '2 ROUTES' picker, hiding the fee comparison by default.
The Amount field is a bare number with an underline and no keyboard/placeholder hint beyond the number itself.
Two capacity references compete: 'Up to 175.00 instantly' (top right) vs 'Your account with H1 115.00' (middle), both about the same reserve.
The fee '0.000050 USDC' is precise but a novice cannot judge 0.00005 as roughly nothing.
fixes: Auto-expand the route picker to show the fee difference whenever more than one route exists.
Label the top-right capacity as 'You can send up to 175.00 right now' and add a tooltip.
Add a humanized fee hint '≈ $0.00' next to the exact fee figure.
Give the Amount field a subtle 'type an amount' placeholder.

top_issues: Four buttons (Copy receipt / Download / Print / PDF / Done) are crammed into one row on a narrow phone, and 'Print / PDF' wraps to two lines.
The proof hash 0x59b55173...195c is truncated and not tappable, so it cannot be copied or verified from the receipt.
The dimmed Home screen behind the modal (including its own 'How to read this' panel) adds visual noise behind the receipt.
'in 9s' is a speed claim with no baseline or comparison.
fixes: Stack the receipt actions as 2x2 or a vertical list with equal-width buttons, and make 'Done' a full-width primary button.
Make the proof hash tappable with a copy icon and a 'copied' confirmation.
Increase the overlay dim and hide the background's explainer while the receipt is open.
Add a comparator to 'in 9s', e.g. 'settled in 9s (vs ~30s on-chain)'.

top_issues: The QR code dominates with no caption telling a first-timer what to do with it.
'Amount optional' defaults to 0.00 with no obvious 'set a fixed amount' affordance, which blocks invoicing use.
'25.50 capacity via H1' is disconnected at the top and not tied to the QR or amount.
'YOUR ENTITY ID' is at the very bottom and easy to miss for a user who wants to share a pay-to ID.
fixes: Add 'Scan this to pay you' as a caption under the QR.
Make Amount a tappable field with placeholder 'Enter an amount (optional)'.
Move the capacity line next to the QR as 'You can receive up to 25.50 right now'.
Surface a shareable preview line: 'You will receive 25.00 USDC from anyone with this link.'

top_issues: The headline 'You receive 0.039992 WETH' is a 6-decimal number that is hard to read or digit-check.
'Hub fee 1 bps · up to 0.0000 WETH' contradicts itself: it reads as a zero fee while claiming 1 bps.
The order book (BOOK) is below the fold and cannot be seen while editing the amount on a phone.
The quote explanation paragraph sits between amount and receive, and net receive is not stated in one bold line.
The swap CTA appears twice (in the main screen and again above the book half).
fixes: Round the headline receive to 4 significant digits with a '≈' and show full precision in a detail row.
Change 'up to 0.0000 WETH' to '0.00 WETH (1 bps)' or show the max fee explicitly.
Show a compact live price ticker above the amount so the book is not required to judge price.
State net in one line: 'You receive ≈ 0.03996 WETH after all fees'.
Remove the duplicate swap CTA above the book.

top_issues: A cross-network swap is interleaved with a full credit-limit setup ('Prepare to receive', collateral slider, 'Extend credit limit'), so a user just trying to swap faces a credit form first.
The 'Account opening requested with zero credit. Prepare incoming capacity after confirmation.' warning appears before the user commits, and the Swap button is disabled, creating a dead-end feeling.
'You receive 0.007998 WETH' vs 'New credit 0.008798 WETH' are two different numbers that are easy to conflate.
The collateral slider and the 100%/50%/0% collateral buttons duplicate the same control.
'Atomic·both legs or neither' is reassuring but buried in the details instead of near the amount.
fixes: Split cross-network swap into two steps: confirm the swap, then a separate 'set up incoming capacity' step.
Replace the disabled button + warning with an enabled button that explains the next step on tap.
Label 'receive' vs 'new credit' distinctly with a visual separator and clear headings.
Remove the duplicate collateral slider, keep only the percentage buttons.
Move 'atomic' next to the amount: 'Atomic: both legs settle or neither does.'

top_issues: 'They owe you, uncovered $90.00' in violet against 'Covered by collateral $0.00' shows real risk but no quantification or mitigation CTA.
'Collateral 60.00' on the USDC card and 'Covered by collateral $0.00' in THIS ACCOUNT look contradictory without a reconciling note.
The 'in flight' legend uses a slanted style that reads as broken rather than a distinct state.
'If you dispute, they answer within 1d' is present but the Dispute action is on a separate top card, not inline here.
fixes: Add an at-risk gauge '$90.00 at risk — add collateral' with a CTA.
Reconcile 'Collateral 60.00' vs 'Covered by collateral $0.00' with a one-line note: '60.00 collateral is held; 0.00 currently covers this balance.'
Restyle 'in flight' as a distinct color/label rather than a slant.
Surface a Dispute action inline in the THIS ACCOUNT card.

top_issues: The filter chips overflow with 'Accou...' truncated and no visible horizontal-scroll affordance.
Status dots and labels are not equally weighted: 'open' (18.58 USDC, the risk signal) reads no stronger than 'closed'.
'Export CSV' exists but there is no per-item export or share receipt action.
'Account opened · created' is weak copy for an event that matters to trust.
fixes: Make the filter row horizontally scrollable with a fade on the right edge.
Give 'open' items a stronger treatment, e.g. a thin amber left border and bolder status.
Add a per-row overflow menu for 'copy receipt / export'.
Reword to 'Account opened with H1 · signed'.

top_issues: 'Frames 2 committed entries' is unexplained, so a user cannot tell why one payment generated two frames.
'To H2 0x92c2d7...cbf0' truncates the address with no copy affordance.
'Via H1' loses the actual route (You → H1 → H2).
The receipt modal has no Copy/Download/Print actions here, inconsistent with the post-payment receipt (03).
fixes: Annotate '2 committed entries' as 'payment + settlement, both signed'.
Make the address tappable with a copy icon.
Show the full route 'You → H1 → H2'.
Add the same Copy/Download/Print actions as the post-payment receipt.

top_issues: The 'AT THIS SCALE' demo is excellent but sits at the very bottom of the settings screen, where it is easy to miss and it consumes a lot of vertical space.
The scale slider (Auto/$1/$2/$5/$10/$25/$100) is not obviously tied to the '1 px = $10' label.
'Reveal recovery phrase' and the red 'Forget vault' are high-risk actions placed adjacently with no confirmation guard.
The HOME toggles (On-chain wallet / Reserve / Accounts) are all ON with no warning about what turning Accounts off would break.
fixes: Move the scale demo into a collapsible panel right under the scale slider.
Label the slider output explicitly as '1 pixel = $10' next to the slider position.
Add a typed confirmation or long-press guard for both 'Reveal recovery phrase' and 'Forget vault'.
Add a caption under the HOME toggles: 'Turning off Accounts removes hub credit; on-chain still works.'

top_issues: The 'up to 40.00 USDC' cap is derived from the FROM selection (Reserve) but displayed without labeling its source, which is confusing when the TO card shows 150.00.
'Add to batch' is a secondary CTA whose purpose (batch multiple moves) is unexplained.
The recipient placeholder '0x... entity id' for a self-move is confusing because empty means 'you' but it shows an id format.
The 3-column FROM/TO cards are tight on a narrow phone and the selected Account card is partially cut at the bottom.
fixes: Label the cap source: 'From Reserve: up to 40.00'.
Add a tooltip explaining 'Add to batch' (queue several moves, then sign once).
Replace the recipient placeholder with 'Leave empty to move to yourself'.
Reduce card padding or use 2 columns on narrow screens, and add bottom padding so the selected card is not cut by the nav bar.

top_issues: The 'WHERE YOUR MONEY STANDS' block is excellent, but 'NEEDS ATTENTION: Nothing waiting on you' is a broad reassurance with no indication of what was checked.
The feature cards (Sovereignty/Move/Assets/Lending/Ownership) are large with small icons and take a lot of space.
The bottom ACCOUNTS list is cut by the nav bar, with the 'H1 hub' chip bleeding off the bottom edge.
Lending is surfaced at the same weight as core actions, but it is not a primary consumer need.
fixes: Add context to 'NEEDS ATTENTION' like 'Checking 3 signals: disputes, expirations, low collateral — none found'.
Reduce the feature-card vertical padding so more content fits.
Fix the bottom ACCOUNTS list truncation by adding bottom padding under the nav bar.
Demote Lending to a secondary row or remove it from the top-level Manage grid.

top_issues: The bottom half is a 'Prepare to receive / credit limit' form, which is out of place on an Assets screen and looks like a stray section.
The green bar under 'Gas 0.1000 ETH' reads as a balance bar, implying 0.1000 ETH is 'good' when it is just gas.
'Depository may pull 0.00' is repeated per token, which is trustworthy but verbose.
'Move into reserve' uses a small arrow button that is less discoverable than a full row.
fixes: Move the credit-limit form to the Account/Receive flow, or clearly label it as a separate 'Incoming capacity' card.
Label the gas indicator as 'gas reserve' so it is not read as an asset balance.
Collapse 'Depository may pull 0.00' to a single summary line plus a per-token detail.
Make 'Move into reserve' a full-width row button.

top_issues: 'Interest you ask·basis points 100 = 1.00% per term' is ambiguous because 'per term' could be 1 hour or 1 day, with wildly different annualized rates.
'Offer to the pool' is disabled (amount 0.00) with no explanation of why or the minimum.
'Hub H1 · 3 lanes' is niche jargon with no gloss.
The pool shows Available/Borrowed/Active principal all 0.00, which communicates nothing and reads as empty.
fixes: Show the annualized rate or clarify the term, e.g. '1.00% per day ≈ 365% per year'.
Explain the disabled state: 'Enter an amount to offer to the pool'.
Gloss '3 lanes' as '3 active trading pairs'.
When the pool is empty, show 'No offers yet — be the first'.

top_issues: 'Self-issued (its id is the hash of its board)' and 'lazy entity' are jargon-heavy for anyone outside a DAO treasury role.
The board-explainer paragraph ('One key runs this entity today. A board can grow to several signers with a quorum (2 of 3, 3 of 5)...') is dense for a single screen.
'TAKE CONTROL OF ANOTHER ENTITY: Nothing to take over' is a niche empty state that takes half the screen.
The 'YOU' signer badge and '1 of 1' threshold are the trust highlights but are small.
fixes: Add a one-line gloss: 'A board is the set of keys that can sign for this entity.'
Collapse the 'take control' empty state to a single line.
Shorten the board explainer to two lines with a 'learn more' link.
Make the 'YOU' badge and '1 of 1' threshold more prominent.

top_issues: 'Enforceable right now $40.00' vs 'Promised $90.00' is the strongest trust moment in the app, but 'co-signed ... as JSON' and 'jurisdiction' are technical.
'they answer in 1d, you in 1d' reads like a symmetric timer but it is actually a dispute window, which is easy to misread.
'Save evidence bundle' is placed in the LEDGER card, not next to the counterparty it covers.
The KEYS/LEDGER sections are heavy and will overwhelm a first-timer (Maya).
fixes: Move 'Save evidence bundle' next to the counterparty (H1) that the bundle covers.
Reword 'they answer in 1d, you in 1d' to 'You have 1 day to dispute; they have 1 day to answer.'
Add a one-line gloss for 'co-signed': 'Both sides signed — neither can deny it later.'
Collapse the KEYS/LEDGER technical details behind a 'Details for auditors' disclosure so first-timers see only the risk summary.

overall.verdict: A genuinely strong, honest fintech design that leads with trust and a one-scale data language; the green-violet 'yours vs promised' split and the co-signed-frame evidence are a real differentiator. The main gaps are flow, where a few screens bury the primary action behind setup forms (cross-network swap, assets), and copy that is occasionally jargon-dense for a first-timer.
priority_fixes: Make the cross-network Swap two-step (confirm the swap, then set up incoming capacity separately) so a user is not forced through a credit-limit form before trading.
Add a persistent dismissed-state to the 'How to read this' explainer and a permanent one-line 'Yours now vs Promised' strip on Home/Manage to de-jargon for first-timers.
Unify the risk visual across Home, Account H1 and Sovereignty into one 'at-risk' figure with an 'add collateral / dispute' CTA.
Fix action density on the receipt and activity screens: vertical or 2x2 buttons, tappable/copyable proof hashes and addresses, and consistent share actions.
Gloss jargon inline (basis points to %, 'lanes', 'co-signed', 'up to 0.0000' fees, 'per term' rates) and round headline amounts to reduce reading effort.

personas.name: Maya
personas.verdict: I could probably pay my friend $20, but I'd be scared by all the talk of hubs, collateral and 'promised' money — and I don't even see how to get cash in.
blockers: No 'add money' / on-ramp screen in the set (Home shows an 'Add money' tab but it is not included), so she cannot complete 'get money in'.
Jargon on Home/Account/Sovereignty: collateral, credit line, Depository, entity id are unexplained for a first-timer.
Receive screen QR has no caption telling her what to do.
Swap screens (05/05b) are far beyond her needs.

personas.name: Tomasz
personas.verdict: In half a minute I can see exactly what is collateralized versus just promised, and the $90 uncovered is the number I care about — this is the clearest credit-risk view I have seen.
blockers: On Account H1, 'Collateral 60.00' vs 'Covered by collateral $0.00' reads contradictory until you read the note.
'Receive up to / send up to' capacity phrasing maps to inbound/outbound liquidity but is not labeled as such.

personas.name: Anya
personas.verdict: The book and 1 bps fee are real, but on a phone I cannot watch the book while I type my swap, the 'up to 0.0000' fee looks like zero, and the history does not show me slippage or fills the way I expect.
blockers: Order book is below the fold — cannot see live price while editing the amount on mobile.
'Hub fee 1 bps · up to 0.0000 WETH' is contradictory (reads as no fee).
Cross-network swap interleaves credit-limit setup before confirming the trade.
Activity history lacks slippage / per-fill detail / fee in USD.

personas.name: Ravi
personas.verdict: I can see exactly what is enforceable on-chain versus what is just promised, and the evidence bundle plus co-signed frames are board-ready — this is what I would want to show our auditors.
blockers: 'Save evidence bundle' is offered but there is no explicit download/export of the signed bundle as a file for the board.
Per-transaction proof (frame/hash/signatures) is shown but the CSV export does not obviously include the signed proof.

personas.name: Sofia
personas.verdict: I can send a payment link and get a receipt, but it is not an invoice — no line items, no due date, no my-business branding — so I would still be doing bookkeeping by hand.
blockers: No invoice screen in the set — Receive is a generic payment link (amount plus note) without due date, line items or business branding.
'Amount optional' defaults to 0.00 with no clear 'set a fixed amount' affordance.
Receipt (08) is a transaction receipt, not a forwardable invoice; 'Print/PDF' is buried under Share.

personas.name: Kenji
personas.verdict: The co-signed frames and 'can dispute without asking' are exactly what I want, but you have shown me the buttons and not the dispute itself — I need to see the countdown, the form and the evidence-bundle viewer.
blockers: No dispute screen in the set — the Dispute button exists but the challenge-window countdown, dispute form and evidence-bundle viewer are missing.
'nothing at risk' per counterparty is a claim I would want to verify against the bundle, not read.

personas.name: Lena
personas.verdict: I can fire a payment in one screen and it is instant, but at a real checkout I would want to scan the merchant's QR — and your Pay screen has no scanner, only Receive does.
blockers: No QR / scan-to-pay on the Pay screen — only Receive shows a QR.
The multi-line 'How to read this' and capacity text push the Pay button below the fold on first open.
The receipt's four buttons in one row are cramped one-handed.

personas.name: Marcus
personas.verdict: For one hub I can see exposure, credit line and collateral — but I run several lanes and I want a single desk table, and a haircut ratio on each line.
blockers: No consolidated 'Desk' table across multiple counterparties in the set (only one hub at a time).
Exposure vs collateral is not shown as a ratio / haircut.
'in flight' legend style is hard to scan.

personas.name: Fatima
personas.verdict: I can see the route and the 1 bps fee, but the app makes me set up a credit account with H3 before I even transfer, and the fee does not add up to one clean number I can check against the recipient.
blockers: Cross-network flow forces credit-limit / collateral setup before confirming the transfer.
Fee is shown as bps + lot rounding + gas, not one total in USD.
No clear 'USDT received on destination network' summary with all fees itemized.

personas.name: Dmitri
personas.verdict: The green/violet 'yours vs promised' split and the one-scale bars tell a genuinely honest story — that is a real differentiator — but I would have to read a lot of small print to be sure, and the small demo numbers do not sell the scale.
blockers: Jargon-dense copy (credit line, collateral, Depository, lanes, entity id, basis points) requires reading effort in a 3-minute skim.
The 'promised $90.00' risk is not surfaced as an explicit loss scenario (e.g. 'if H1 vanishes you lose $90') anywhere prominent.
Demo numbers are tiny ($40–$115), so the five-to-six-figure use case is not evident.
